description.p: This page documents the visible properties returned by properties for a parameterizedfunctionline graphics object.

tr.td: updates automatic axes limits.
Type: finite numeric vector. Supported values: two finite values [min max].
updates rendered output on refresh.
Type: on/off value. Supported values: 'on', 'off', true, or false.
updates annotation metadata.
Type: graphics annotation object. Supported values: annotation handle or empty handle.
reports object deletion state.
Type: text scalar. Supported values: 'off' or 'on'.
controls callback queuing.
Type: text scalar. Supported values: 'queue' or 'cancel'.
runs on mouse-button events.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, text, or callback cell array.
updates with object parenting.
Type: graphics handle vector. Supported values: empty vector or child handles.
controls clipping to axes limits.
Type: text scalar. Supported values: 'on' or 'off'.
changes line color.
Type: color value. Supported values: color names, short color names, RGB triplet, hexadecimal color, or 'none'.
selects automatic or manual color.
Type: text scalar. Supported values: 'auto' or 'manual'.
attaches a context menu.
Type: graphics handle scalar. Supported values: [] or uicontextmenu handle.
runs when the object is created.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, text, or callback cell array.
updates the data tip content shown by interactive data tips.
Type: data tip template object or empty value. Supported values: a data tip template object or an empty value.
runs when the object is deleted.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, text, or callback cell array.
sets the legend label.
Type: text value. Supported values: character row vector or string scalar.
controls handle discovery.
Type: text scalar. Supported values: 'on', 'off', or 'callback'.
controls mouse hit testing.
Type: text scalar. Supported values: 'on' or 'off'.
controls callback interruption.
Type: text scalar. Supported values: 'on' or 'off'.
changes joins between segments.
Type: text scalar. Supported values: 'miter', 'round', or 'chamfer'.
changes line style.
Type: text scalar. Supported values: '-', '--', ':', '-.', or 'none'.
selects automatic or manual style.
Type: text scalar. Supported values: 'auto' or 'manual'.
changes line width.
Type: finite numeric scalar. Supported values: values greater than or equal to 0.
changes marker symbol.
Type: text scalar. Supported values: marker names, marker characters, or 'none'.
changes marker edge color.
Type: color value. Supported values: color values, 'auto', 'none', or 'flat'.
changes marker face color.
Type: color value. Supported values: color values, 'auto', 'none', or 'flat'.
selects marked data points.
Type: positive integer vector. Supported values: indices into plotted data or empty value.
selects automatic or manual markers.
Type: text scalar. Supported values: 'auto' or 'manual'.
changes marker size.
Type: finite numeric scalar. Supported values: finite scalar value.
controls function sampling density.
Type: positive integer scalar. Supported values: integer greater than 1.
reparents the object.
Type: graphics handle scalar. Supported values: axes or hggroup handle.
selects parts that receive mouse hits.
Type: text scalar. Supported values: 'visible', 'all', or 'none'.
updates polar radius data.
Type: numeric vector. Supported values: [] or finite/infinite numeric data.
selects automatic or manual radius data.
Type: text scalar. Supported values: 'auto' or 'manual'.
stores radius data source text.
Type: text value. Supported values: empty text or variable name.
stores radius variable text.
Type: text value. Supported values: empty text or variable name.
changes selection state.
Type: text scalar. Supported values: 'on' or 'off'.
controls selection highlighting.
Type: text scalar. Supported values: 'on' or 'off'.
stores series ordering.
Type: integer scalar. Supported values: finite integer value.
binds the object data to a table; the variable properties select columns.
Type: table. Supported values: empty table or a table providing bound variables.
sets the parameter sampling interval.
Type: two-element numeric row vector. Supported values: increasing finite interval [tmin tmax].
selects automatic or manual parameter range.
Type: text scalar. Supported values: 'auto' or 'manual'.
stores an object identifier.
Type: text value. Supported values: empty text or identifier text.
updates polar angle data.
Type: numeric vector. Supported values: [] or finite/infinite numeric data.
selects automatic or manual angle data.
Type: text scalar. Supported values: 'auto' or 'manual'.
stores angle data source text.
Type: text value. Supported values: empty text or variable name.
stores angle variable text.
Type: text value. Supported values: empty text or variable name.
reports the object type.
Type: read-only text. Supported values: 'parameterizedfunctionline'.
stores user data.
Type: Nelson array. Supported values: any Nelson value.
controls object visibility.
Type: text scalar. Supported values: 'on' or 'off'.
stores sampled x data.
Type: numeric vector. Supported values: [] or numeric row/column vector.
selects automatic or manual x data.
Type: text scalar. Supported values: 'auto' or 'manual'.
updates the stored object state.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: empty text or a workspace/table variable name.
stores the function sampled for x data.
Type: function value. Supported values: function handle or empty value.
updates the stored object state.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: empty text or a workspace/table variable name.
